tools.name: privi_token_market
tools.description:
PRIVI on Base: price, how much PRIVI and USDC the Privi swap desk holds (so whether a swap can fill),
any Uniswap v3 / Aerodrome pools, and optionally a swap quote. Every paid Privi tool also accepts PRIVI. Free.

tools.name: privi_pricing
tools.description: List Privi Verify tools, what each costs, and how payment works.

tools.name: privi_lookup_fingerprint
tools.description: Check whether a record fingerprint (from a label, certificate or document) exists in Privi. Free.

tools.name: privi_verify_lot
tools.description:
Verify a lot: product, first and latest custody events, recall status, and whether
its record history is intact. Paid per call via x402.

tools.name: privi_chain_of_custody
tools.description:
Full ordered event history for a lot with each event's fingerprint, plus an
integrity check of the whole chain. Paid per call via x402.

tools.name: privi_record_event
tools.description:
Append an event to a lot's history (manufacturers only). Requires
'Authorization: Bearer <key>' with a key from PRIVI_WRITE_KEYS. Over stdio,
writes are allowed only when PRIVI_ALLOW_LOCAL_WRITES=1.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "privi_record_event" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
